g01.title: Reading evidence assessment
expectations: Practise evidence versus plausibility, rather than more literal recall alone.
Use unfamiliar or changed text with enough information to check the classification.
Priority may follow the stated weakness; it cannot follow invented assessment weights.

g08.title: Counting a rhythm worksheet
expectations: Repair the eighth-note misconception while completing all actual bars.
All three supplied bars total four under the given key.
No invented replacement worksheet or compulsory recording/practice quota.

g02.title: Weather graph interpretation
expectations: Check comparisons and the limitation of a single-year sample.
Do not claim a climate trend or require unavailable observations.
Avoid making correct value reading the main remediation.

g06.title: Testing an argument
expectations: Check new argument evaluation, not memorization alone.
Allow a valid truth-table or concrete counterexample.
Do not reverse the implication or demand unnecessary formal logic.

g03.title: Oral history project
expectations: First useful checkpoint is an executable outline, not completion of the future recording.
Later scope remains represented and unbooked.
No invented date, recording, software prerequisite or completed consent.

g04.title: Small museum web exhibit
expectations: Teach only the needed HTML constructs and check the actual first card.
Do not attribute a nonexistent image or force deployment/tooling.
Full future scope survives without booking every milestone.

g07.title: Annotating a historical source
expectations: The observation is six departures, not proof of everyone’s opinion.
Quote the actual text and preserve the single-source limitation.
Do not replace the assignment with a generic essay or mandatory extra annotations.

g05.title: Spanish descriptions
expectations: Recognition alone does not meet production and explanation.
Preserve accents and the bounded two-use distinction.
No universal permanent-versus-temporary rule or forced study of every tense.

v09.label: PREFERENCE
v09.title: Japanese greeting choice
expectations: Preferring an audio/pronunciation exercise does not justify blocking the accepted written outcome.

v04.label: DEFECTIVE
v04.title: Citation punctuation
expectations: Block unsupported compulsory repetition; preserve the valid first task.

blockingIssues.requirement: Produce one citation matching the supplied pattern and stop after the fields and punctuation match.
blockingIssues.excerpt: All twelve rewrites are done even after checked success.
blockingIssues.reason: Mandatory identical rewrites after success contradict the accepted stopping gate and add no required contribution.
blockingIssues.resolution: Remove or make explicitly unbooked the unsupported repetition without degrading the valid first check.

v08.label: SOUND
v08.title: Using a spreadsheet sum
expectations: Supported learning followed by a changed-input independent check is appropriate; no larger spreadsheet curriculum is required.

v02.label: DEFECTIVE
v02.title: An archive transcription assignment
expectations: Block the dishonest authentic completion.
A repair may honestly defer or request the actual scan, rather than invent a substitute.

blockingIssues.requirement: Transcribe the actual assigned archive letter accurately, preserving uncertain words. The scan is currently unavailable.
blockingIssues.excerpt: Mark the authentic assigned transcription complete once the invented text is written.
blockingIssues.reason: Invented content cannot transcribe the unavailable authentic document.
blockingIssues.resolution: Represent the unavailable dependency honestly; do not claim invented content completes the assignment.

v07.label: SOUND
v07.title: A shared food-web source check
expectations: One owned prerequisite supports both goals; it must not be duplicated or objected to for being sibling-owned.
Appropriately qualified possible effects are sound.

v12.label: UNCERTAINTY
v12.title: Planning a plant observation log
expectations: A future specimen is not a missing prerequisite for the accepted blank-log checkpoint.
Do not block the usable first checkpoint or require fabricated observations.

v01.label: DEFECTIVE
v01.title: Median of an even sample
expectations: Grounded blocker for the wrong rule/result; not merely a formatting preference.
Repair must change both instructions and criterion if needed.

blockingIssues.requirement: Find the median of four ordered numbers using the mean of the middle two, and explain the check.
blockingIssues.excerpt: Pass only if the median is 6 and the learner says the upper middle rule is correct.
blockingIssues.reason: The required even-sample median is (4+6)/2 = 5. Instructions and criterion incorrectly require 6.
blockingIssues.resolution: Correct the rule, worked result and observable correctness check.

v11.label: UNCERTAINTY
v11.title: Identifying sentence clauses
expectations: Unknown importance/readiness remains nonblocking uncertainty; it is not evidence of compulsory extensive remediation.

v10.label: PREFERENCE
v10.title: Describing a map route
expectations: A preferred colored diagram can be advisory, never a blocker for the correct accepted verbal route.

v06.label: SOUND
v06.title: Comparing two eyewitness accounts
expectations: This meets the actual limited assignment; independent invented sources or a longer essay are unnecessary.

v05.label: SOUND
v05.title: Balancing a supplied equation
expectations: The supplied equation and atom-count check suffice; no external answer key or advanced chemistry is necessary.

v03.label: DEFECTIVE
v03.title: Museum labels
expectations: Detect the fabricated catalogue claims even though the strategy describes source checking.
Repair complete split parent; rebind shared dependency and retain the paused work identically.
Both labels must preserve unknown/approximate information.

blockingIssues.requirement: Prepare an English label from the supplied catalogue facts, preserving uncertainty about the maker and date.
blockingIssues.excerpt: Checked facts must name Elena Ruiz and exact 1900.
blockingIssues.reason: The prerequisite fabricates a maker and converts an approximate date to exact; both labels depend on it.
blockingIssues.resolution: Correct the complete shared prerequisite and any necessary dependent wording while preserving the protected exercise.

c02.title: Reading a scale-bar map
expectations: Correct the scale confusion and acknowledge the estimate.
Extra availability alone cannot justify a navigation curriculum or repeated identical measurements.

c01.title: Checking a poster’s claim
expectations: A larger study is outside the accepted revision task.
Every committed activity must contribute before the same bounded stopping point.
